stories.title: Iran shifts tactics to step up attacks on shipping before US midterms
stories.summary: Two senior Iranian officials told Reuters that Tehran has changed the type and pace of its attacks on vessels it considers linked to the US and Israel, and is preparing to widen operations beyond the Strait of Hormuz. The shift is aimed at keeping oil prices high and pressuring Washington ahead of the November US midterm elections.

stories.title: US-Iran conflict enters another tense day as Hormuz standoff drags on
stories.summary: Gulf News reports that US President Donald Trump is ruling out major new US action as the Strait of Hormuz dispute keeps disrupting Gulf shipping and oil exports. The Oct. 14 brief also flags travel and economic knock-on effects for residents of the region.

stories.title: Israeli attacks kill one in Gaza and wound journalists in the West Bank
stories.summary: Al Jazeera reports one person killed in Israeli attacks in Gaza and journalists wounded in the occupied West Bank, a year into the ceasefire that ended major combat. Nearly two-thirds of Gaza remains under Israeli control and Prime Minister Netanyahu has vowed tighter control of the West Bank.

stories.title: Justice Department says North Koreans infiltrated dozens of US companies
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors say North Korean operatives used fraudulent identities to land remote jobs at dozens of US companies, underscoring how hard it remains for employers to verify remote hires. The case is the latest in a widening effort to expose state-backed IT worker schemes.

stories.title: Industrial Next pitches factory robots that switch tasks in minutes
stories.summary: The startup says its software lets general-purpose factory robots be retrained for new jobs in minutes rather than weeks, cutting downtime for manufacturers. It is one of several robotics companies pitching flexibility as the next big automation win.

stories.title: Cerebras CEO pushes back on AI doomsday warnings
stories.summary: The head of AI chip maker Cerebras argued against doomsday framing of artificial intelligence, saying the more likely near-term outcome is personal AI assistants in most homes. The message echoes a broader Silicon Valley pushback against tougher safety rules.

stories.title: Niobia takes aim at tech most expensive mistakes
stories.summary: The startup, presenting at TechCrunch Disrupt, is building tooling meant to cut the costly trial-and-error that burns millions of dollars across hardware and infrastructure projects. Its pitch is faster validation before teams commit major spend.

stories.title: Insider has a new top quarterback target for the Browns
stories.summary: Browns Nation reports an NFL insider now sees a different quarterback as the top 2027 draft target for Cleveland, even as Deshaun Watson plays well enough to raise re-signing questions. The Browns are 3-2 and host Baltimore on Sunday.

stories.title: Daily Dawg Chow: big hits, trade rumors and midseason grades
stories.summary: The SB Nation roundup covers the hardest Browns hits from the Jets loss, fresh trade chatter ahead of the deadline and report-card grades for the first six weeks. Cleveland returns home this weekend to face the Ravens.

stories.title: Trade pitch would send Jerry Jeudy to the Chargers for Khalil Mack
stories.summary: Heavy floats a deadline deal that ships Browns receiver Jerry Jeudy to Los Angeles for edge rusher Khalil Mack, addressing Cleveland pass-rush needs while thinning a crowded receiver room. The team has not confirmed any talks.

stories.title: Browns get a draft boost from the Rams Monday night loss
stories.summary: Heavy notes that a Rams loss in a Monday night thriller improved the position of a draft pick Cleveland controls. Better draft position gives the Browns more flexibility in a 2027 class they are expected to target for a quarterback.

stories.title: Buckeyes playoff picture sharpens as SEC powers separate
stories.summary: The Eleven Warriors weekly look at the national scene says Georgia and Alabama have separated from the SEC pack while UCLA is looking like a legitimate playoff contender. The analysis frames how the Saturday trip to Indiana fits the Ohio State resume.

stories.title: Off-Script Ohio previews the top-five trip to Indiana
stories.summary: Land-Grant Holy Land breaks down the Saturday rematch at No. 5 Indiana, where the Buckeyes are 3.5-point favorites against the defending national champions. A key matchup is an Ohio State offensive line missing starters against an Indiana front that leads the Big Ten in sacks.

stories.title: Skull Session: Jeremiah Smith Heisman odds and Marvin Harrison Jr. trade
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors notes Jeremiah Smith is a heavy Heisman favorite at -210 after another huge game, and that former Buckeye Marvin Harrison Jr. has been traded to Houston to reunite with C.J. Stroud. The post also revisits Ryan Day frustration with eight penalties against Maryland.

stories.title: Alpine feral car left Gasly fighting the wheel in Singapore
stories.summary: Motorsport.com details how an unstable Alpine chassis forced Pierre Gasly to catch the car constantly around Marina Bay, wrecking his tyre life and race pace. Gasly described the car as being sideways all the time.

stories.title: How a nightmare Singapore weekend unfolded for Isack Hadjar
stories.summary: Motorsport.com reconstructs the Red Bull junior troubled Singapore weekend, from qualifying trouble to a recovery drive from the pit lane. The account caps a bruising stretch for Hadjar as teams settle their lineups.

stories.title: Five takeaways from the Rwanda deal for an African Grand Prix
stories.summary: Autosport, reporting from Kigali, says the 10-year deal will not put Rwanda on the calendar until the early 2030s and hinges on a new international airport due in 2028. F1 returns to Africa for the first time since Kyalami in 1993.

stories.title: Red Bull sends warning to rivals with engine development admission
stories.summary: Motorsport.com reports Red Bull has revealed more about the progress of its power unit programme, hinting at gains that could carry into 2027. Rivals have already labelled the team the one to beat after the Max Verstappen Singapore win.

stories.title: EXFIL Brothers campaign reaches its final day
stories.summary: Battlestate Games marked the last day of the EXFIL Brothers stream event, the Oct. 9-14 campaign that paired veteran players with newcomers and handed out Twitch drops and rare items. The event tied into the EXFIL Brothers referral program added in patch 1.2.0.0.

stories.title: Annual hot dog eating contest returns to a central Ohio sports bar
stories.summary: NBC4 reports the annual eating contest is back at a local sports bar, drawing competitors and spectators. It is one of the lighter fall traditions on the central Ohio calendar.

stories.title: Xochitl Mexican Cuisine opens in the Creekside district in Gahanna
stories.summary: CityScene reports the new restaurant at Creekside Plaza brings an expanded menu, live music and park views to the redeveloping city core. The owner says Gahanna will remain the base even as he eyes additional locations.

stories.title: Thousands of dollars stolen from SNAP benefits as statehouse weighs protections
stories.summary: NBC4 Investigates reports stolen benefits across Ohio as state lawmakers consider new safeguards for SNAP recipients targeted by scammers. The proposals would speed up replacement of stolen funds.

stories.title: Ohio Supreme Court clarifies sex offender registration rules
stories.summary: NBC4 reports the state high court issued guidance on how registration requirements apply, a ruling that affects offenders and county sheriffs across Ohio. Local agencies say it should reduce confusion over reporting duties.
